hero.title: Building a Sarawak Builder Community
hero.subtitle: Sarawak.Dev exists to lower barriers and create pathways for everyone to participate in digital creation.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: To become the leading builder community platform for Sarawak by enabling students, beginners, professionals, and local communities to learn modern digital skills, create real projects, and grow through collaboration.

mission.title: Mission
mission.description: Sarawak.Dev exists to lower the barrier for people to enter technology, AI-assisted creation, and digital building by providing a clear starting point, a supportive learning community, visible project outcomes, a pathway from learner to builder, and a local ecosystem that encourages contribution, collaboration, and long-term growth.

whyMatters.title: Why Sarawak.Dev Matters
problems: Many people don't know where to start with coding or tech
Coding often feels too difficult or too technical
There's a lack of local communities that feel relevant and welcoming
Most people consume content but never build real projects
Existing communities can feel fragmented or disconnected from local culture

groups.title: Students
groups.description: University and college students looking for skills, portfolio work, and community.

groups.title: Beginners
groups.description: New to coding or AI tools and needing a simple, motivating first step.

groups.title: Career Switchers
groups.description: Interested in entering digital work and wanting practical exposure.

groups.title: Builders
groups.description: Developers, designers, and creators looking for collaboration and local impact.

hero.title: Vibe Coding
hero.subtitle: Your builder entry experience. Not just learning to code — learning to build, create, and share something real.

whatIs.title: What is Vibe Coding?
whatIs.description: Vibe Coding is the first experience every new Sarawak.Dev member should join. It is designed to make technology feel approachable, creative, and empowering. It is not a deep technical course — it is a builder entry experience.

outcomes.title: What You'll Achieve
items: Understand the basics of AI-assisted building
Create a small but working digital project
Describe and present what you built
Share your work with the community

items.title: Introduction
items.description: What is Vibe Coding, what is AI-assisted creation, and why building matters more than just consuming.

items.title: First Build
items.description: Choose a simple project, use prompts or templates to generate a starting point, and preview your output.

items.title: Improve & Personalize
items.description: Change layout, content, style, or interaction. Learn basic iteration habits.

items.title: Publish & Share
items.description: Present your project, explain what you built, and share it with the community.

cta.title: Ready to Start Building?
cta.description: Join the next Vibe Coding cohort and experience the joy of building something real.

hero.title: Become an Ambassador
hero.subtitle: Help spread Sarawak.Dev and connect your community to a builder ecosystem.

why.title: Why Ambassadors Matter
why.description: The ambassador system makes Sarawak.Dev easier to spread, localize, and activate across different groups. Ambassadors are distributed promoters and connectors who represent their campus, community, or domain.

items.title: Founding Ambassador
items.description: Early believers who help establish Sarawak.Dev from the ground up.

items.title: Campus Ambassador
items.description: Represent Sarawak.Dev at your university or college.

items.title: Partner Community Ambassador
items.description: Bridge your community with Sarawak.Dev's network.

items.title: Project Ambassador
items.description: Champion specific programs like Vibe Coding.

items.title: Regional Ambassador
items.description: Represent a specific geographic area or region.

responsibilities.title: Responsibilities
items: Invite new members to the community
Help coordinate a local sharing session or outreach effort

benefits.title: What You Gain
items: Pathway to mentor or organizer roles

cta.title: Ready to Lead?
cta.description: Apply to become a Sarawak.Dev ambassador and help build the community.
